title: On What Has Now Been Sown
description: On What Has Now Been Sown in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by John Newton, first published in 1779. The tune, DARWALL, is by John Darwall (1770). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: On what has now been sown Thy bless-ing, Lord, be-stow; The pow'r is Thine a-lone To make it spring and grow. Do Thou in grace the har-vest raise, And Thou a-lone shalt have the praise.

lines: On what has now been sown
To make it spring and grow.
Do Thou in grace the harvest raise,
And Thou alone shalt have the praise.
To Thee our wants are known,
From Thee are all our pow'rs;
Our praises, Lord, and prayers receive
And to Thy Word a blessing give.
Oh, grant that each of us
And follow Thee to Heav'n, our home.
E'en so, Amen, Lord Jesus, come!
